title: High Strength and Fracture Resistance of Reduced-Activity W-Ta-Ti-V-Zr High-Entropy Alloy for Fusion Energy Applications.

recollection.structure: guess: refined grain structure or improved crystal lattice
recollection.mechanism: guess: increased strength and fracture resistance due to alloying effects and reduced activity
recollection.results: guess: improved mechanical properties such as strength, toughness, and resistance to radiation damage

score.note: The recollection does not identify arc melting/remelting or the comparative mechanical testing, and it misreads 'reduced-activity' as an intervention. The proposed refined-grain structure is unsupported and misses the segregated dual-BCC dendritic microstructure. 'Alloying effects' is only a generic mechanism. The results merely repeat the title-level claims of improved strength and fracture resistance, with no numerical values; radiation-damage resistance was not an actual reported result.
